verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents a first-party, Snowflake-managed MCP server that lets AI agents securely retrieve account data without separate infrastructure. It can be configured to serve Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, custom tools and SQL execution, and a probe confirms the official MCP doc page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully, and evidence of client connection and authentication setup details.
